description: Side-by-side comparison of 2–4 loan scenarios (e.g. 60 vs 72 months, dealer vs credit-union APR, more down). Each result has a share_url; differences are against the first scenario, plus which is cheapest overall and lowest monthly. When optional inputs are omitted, the result includes assumed_defaults (the values actually used) and a short text line so you can call again with those parameters. assumed_defaults is omitted when every optional input was provided. On this tool, assumed_defaults is per scenario; a top-level assumed_defaults is included only when country was omitted.

country.description: Country for every scenario, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Default "US"; only US is available for now.

scenarios.description: 2–4 scenarios. The first is the baseline for differences.

apr.description: Yearly interest rate in percent, compounded monthly (the same number as the site’s rate field), e.g. 6.5 for 6.5%. A lender’s APR can be a little higher because it folds in some fees. Use 0 for 0% financing.

down.description: Cash down payment in USD. Default 0.

fees.description: Title, registration, documentation and dealer fees in USD. Default 0.

owed_on_trade_in.description: Loan balance still owed on the trade-in, rolled into the new loan (negative equity). Default 0.

price.description: Vehicle price in USD (before tax, fees, down payment and trade-in).

sales_tax_rate.description: Sales tax in percent of the vehicle price, e.g. 7 for 7%. No state rules or trade-in tax credit are applied. Default 0.

tax_and_fees_financed.description: false (default, the site's "Pay upfront"): sales tax and fees are paid in cash at purchase, not financed. true: they are added to the loan.

trade_in.description: Trade-in value in USD credited against the price. Default 0.

name: compare_auto_loans

assumed_defaults.description: Optional inputs the caller omitted, with the values actually used. The field is omitted when nothing was assumed.
